events.title: Ray-Ban Stories launches
events.summary: Meta and EssilorLuxottica launched Ray-Ban Stories, establishing a major consumer camera-and-open-ear-audio smart-glasses line in conventional eyewear.

events.title: Ray-Ban Meta smart glasses announced
events.summary: Meta announced its next generation of Ray-Ban smart glasses with improved capture, audio, livestreaming, and Meta AI integration.

events.title: Snap introduces fifth-generation Spectacles and Snap OS
events.summary: Snap introduced standalone see-through AR Spectacles powered by the new Snap OS and made them available through its developer program.

events.title: XREAL One establishes an on-glasses spatial-computing chip architecture
events.summary: XREAL identifies the One generation as a 2024 milestone centered on its in-house X1 spatial-computing chip, marking a shift toward more processing inside display glasses.

events.title: Google announces Android XR
events.summary: Google announced Android XR as an Android platform for next-generation headsets and glasses, built with Samsung and Qualcomm and designed around Gemini-era experiences.

events.title: Ray-Ban Meta Gen 2 launches
events.summary: Meta launched the second generation of Ray-Ban Meta glasses with longer battery life and improved video capture, extending the consumer AI-glasses line.

events.title: GlassesResearch canonical device database established
events.summary: GlassesResearch formalized The List as a machine-readable canonical device database with stable GLS identifiers and validation.

events.title: GlassesResearch comparison engine established
events.summary: A schema-driven comparison engine was added so devices can be compared using the same evidence-aware field model without hand-written winner narratives.

events.title: GlassesResearch comparison research begins
events.summary: The comparison system received its first six evidence-backed device records, moving from infrastructure to usable research data.

events.title: GlassesResearch artifact preservation archive established
events.summary: The project created a provenance-first archive for firmware, SDKs, applications, manuals, regulatory records, tools, and open hardware with validation and preservation metadata.
